questions.prompt: The model adds a fourth todo in the middle of the task. Why does nothing break?
options: Each call sends the whole list, so no change depends on the old item numbers
The harness merges the new todo into the old list
The tool rejects lists longer than three
The fourth todo goes into the next turn
questions.explanation: A whole-list write does not refer to the old list, so adding, removing or reordering items is the same kind of call.

questions.prompt: A screen opens the session after four todo_write calls in one turn. What does it show?
options: The first list, because the record keeps it first
The fourth list, because the newest write wins
Nothing, until the model calls the tool again
questions.explanation: The projection reads the events in order and keeps the latest todo/write, so the fourth list is shown.

questions.prompt: With one todo allowed in progress, the model marks two as in_progress. What happens?
options: The second one is silently changed to pending
The tool throws, and the model reads an error result and tries again
Both are saved and the screen shows a warning
questions.explanation: checkTodos rejects the list. The failure returns as a tool error result, so the model can send a corrected list.
